fullPassage: One of the most important aspects of sustaining long-term relationships is communication. It's easy to connect with someone and then let the relationship get stuck due to a lack of follow-up. To keep the connection alive, make a conscious effort to stay in touch. This doesn't mean constantly reaching out with requests or updates but rather maintaining a friendly and consistent line of communication. A simple message to check in or share something of value can go a long way in reinforcing your relationship. For example, if you come across an article or resource that you think might interest a connection, share it with them, even if you haven't spoken in a while. This shows that you're thinking of them and are invested in maintaining the relationship.

"연락을 유지하기 위해 의식적인 노력을 하라."
조건: make, conscious, effort를 포함할 것

det.korean: 연락을 유지하기 위해 의식적인 노력을 하라.
det.analysis: ✅ Make a conscious effort to stay: 원문 'make a conscious effort to stay in touch'에서 핵심 5단어
det.tip: make a conscious effort = 의식적 노력을 하다

questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로 다음 우리말을 영작하시오. (4단어)
"연결을 살아있게 유지하다"에 해당하는 영어 표현을 쓰시오.
조건: keep, connection을 포함할 것

det.korean: 연결을 살아있게 유지하다
det.analysis: ✅ keep the connection alive: 원문 'To keep the connection alive'에서. keep + O + 형용사보어
det.tip: keep the connection alive = 연결을 살아있게 유지하다
